<json>
{
  "states": [
    "ConnectionOpen",
    "GreetingSent",
    "SessionReady",
    "MailFromSet",
    "RecipientAdded",
    "DataTransferActive",
    "TransactionComplete",
    "SessionClosed"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "ConnectionOpen",
      "event": "receive connection",
      "action": "reply 220",
      "to": "GreetingSent"
    },
    {
      "from": "GreetingSent",
      "event": "receive EHLO",
      "action": "reply 250",
      "to": "SessionReady"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionReady",
      "event": "receive MAIL FROM",
      "action": "reply 250",
      "to": "MailFromSet"
    },
    {
      "from": "MailFromSet",
      "event": "receive RCPT TO",
      "action": "reply 250",
      "to": "RecipientAdded"
    },
    {
      "from": "RecipientAdded",
      "event": "receive RCPT TO",
      "action": "reply 250",
      "to": "RecipientAdded"
    },
    {
      "from": "RecipientAdded",
      "event": "receive DATA",
      "action": "reply 354",
      "to": "DataTransferActive"
    },
    {
      "from": "DataTransferActive",
      "event": "receive end_of_data",
      "action": "reply 250",
      "to": "TransactionComplete"
    },
    {
      "from": "TransactionComplete",
      "event": "cond transaction_end",
      "action": "reset state",
      "to": "SessionReady"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionReady",
      "event": "receive QUIT",
      "action": "reply 221",
      "to": "SessionClosed"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
